title: Rural Home Loans Delinquency Timelines
content:
Day counts and limits that govern late monthly payments on the Rural Home Loans products.

## Items

- **Grace days** — calendar days after the due date before a late charge arises.
- **Courtesy waivers** — late charges waivable as a courtesy per loan in any rolling 12 months.
- **Nonaccrual threshold** — calendar days a monthly payment may stay unpaid before nonaccrual.

## Table

| Product | Grace days | Courtesy waivers per rolling 12 months | Nonaccrual threshold (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 15 | 1 | 90 |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 15 | 1 | 90 |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 15 | 1 | 90 |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 15 | 1 | 90 |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 15 | 1 | 90 |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 15 | 1 | 90 |

## Note

The three figures are identical across the six Country Home products: 15 grace days, 1 courtesy waiver in any rolling 12 months, and a 90-day nonaccrual threshold.
